name: manage_reflexes
description: Entity: Lynx. Inspect, create, enable, or disable autonomous reflex rules that trigger instant reactions to sensory patterns.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against incoming sense events (e.g. 'touch.*hold', 'magnet.*wand')

command.description: Command or script to execute when the pattern matches (e.g. '/usr/local/bin/lynx-agent-haptic --pulse 120')

description.description: Optional human explanation of what the reflex does

id.description: Reflex ID (for enable or disable actions)

event.description: Event line to test against reflexes
